title: Returned Payments on LandlordGuard Policies: Fee Rule and Fee Entry
content:
On the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy a returned-payment fee is charged once for each returned payment and points at that returned payment; a returned payment found without its fee is charged on the day it is found. No returned-payment fee is charged on a mortgagee-billed term or on a tier whose returned-payment fee is 0.00.

## One fee per returned payment

| Returned payment on the premium account | Returned-payment fee |
|---|---|
| no fee entry pointing at it | one fee, pointing at it |
| a fee entry already points at it | no further fee |
| on a mortgagee-billed term, or on a tier whose fee is 0.00 | none |

## Situation of use and capability

`assess_returned_payment_fee_55a26ad1` charges the returned-payment fee for one returned payment on a LandlordGuard dwelling policy. One call posts one returned-payment fee entry on the policy's premium account that points at the returned payment it is charged for, and raises the premium balance by the fee; the fee then shows on the premium account next to the returned payment.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `assess_returned_payment_fee_55a26ad1`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `dwelling_policy_id` | the reference id of the landlord dwelling policy record, as returned by the dwelling policy lookup for the verified caller | identifier |
| `source_billing_id` | the reference id of the returned-payment entry on the premium account the fee is charged for, as returned by the premium ledger lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | the returned-payment fee in USD | positive amount to 2 decimal places; a value with more places is rounded half-up to 2 decimal places when posted |

## Return

A one-line receipt: "Returned-payment fee posted: entry <entry_id> on policy <dwelling_policy_id> for returned payment <source_billing_id>, <amount> USD on <posted_date>." The entry id is the new premium-ledger entry, the policy and returned payment are echoed, the amount is shown to 2 decimal places and the posted date is YYYY-MM-DD. Receiving this line means the fee is posted.
